title: 第12章 华夏神话断层，外国诸神林立，让夏晚晴开局唤醒孙悟空吧
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: 那朵嚣张至极的金色祥云猛地刹住车，惯性卷起的气浪吹得叶凛袖子上的红袖章猎猎作响。猴子落地了。不是那种轻飘飘的仙人落地。而是仿佛多动症晚期那般，直接从云头上翻了个跟头，双脚稳稳踩在白玉地砖上。金甲撞击，脆响悦耳。孙悟空把抗在肩上的金箍棒换了个手。他滴溜溜乱转的眼睛先是扫了一圈蟠桃园的牌匾，然后才漫不经心地落在了坐在小马扎上的叶凛身上。一个凡人？孙悟空挠了挠满是金毛的手背，有些纳闷。这天庭什么时候穷酸成这样了？这么大个蟠桃园，没有天兵把守，没有土地迎送。就放个连法力波动都没有的凡人在这儿晒太阳？“嘿！”孙悟空呲了呲牙，发出一声怪叫，根本没把叶凛当回事。此时的孙悟空刚刚大闹天宫，被封为弼马温，正处于“老子天下第一，谁都要给面子”的膨胀期。他迈着那标志性的六亲不认步，大摇大摆地就要往园子里闯。他是谁？齐天大圣！这天庭里，除了凌霄宝殿和兜率宫他还会稍微收敛点，这种果园子那不是想进就进？一步。两步。就在孙悟空的一只脚即将跨过那道无形的界限时。咚——！孙悟空毫无防备，整个人被这股反震力弹得向后仰去，连退了三步才站稳。“嗯？”猴子愣住了。他伸手摸了摸鼻子，有点酸。前方明明空无一物，连一丝灵气波动的涟漪都没有。“哪路神仙跟俺老孙开玩笑？”孙悟空歪着脑袋，强大的精神力像探照灯一样在蟠桃园门口扫来扫去。没有阵法。没有结界。也没有什么隐身的护法神将。只有那个坐在小马扎上的凡人，正低着头，拿着一支看起来很奇怪的东西，在一个小本子上写写画画。叶凛连头都没抬。他当然知道猴子来了。但他现在的身份是保安。保安守则第一条：敌不动，我不动；敌若动，我看戏；敌若硬闯，自有门禁。系统给的【绝对门禁】是概念技。什么叫概念？就是我说这里有门，这里就有门。我说这门锁了，就算你是把天道磨灭了也进不来。孙悟空不信邪。他可是从石头缝里蹦出来的，这辈子字典里就没有“不行”这两个字。“好个怪事。”孙悟空把金箍棒往地上一杵，震得玉石地面嗡嗡作响。“俺老孙就不信，这破门还能拦得住我！”既然走不进去，那就飞进去！孙悟空身形一晃，整个人化作一道金线，直冲云霄，打算从上方越过那道无形的墙。叶凛翻了一页纸，顺手端起那个印着“替天行道”的大茶缸，抿了一口枸杞水。砰！半空中传来一声脆响。那道金线像是撞在了一块看不见的天花板上，直挺挺地掉了下来，砸在地上摔了个狗啃泥。“呸呸呸！”孙悟空从地上爬起来，吐出嘴里的草屑，那张雷公脸涨得通红。太丢猴了！想他堂堂美猴王，大闹龙宫，强销生死簿，什么时候吃过这种暗亏？“我就不信了！”孙悟空这下是真的急眼了。他拔下一根毫毛，放在嘴边吹了一口气。“变！”那毫毛迎风一晃，变成了一只指甲盖大小的蜜蜂。翅膀震动，发出嗡嗡的声响。既然正门走不通，上面飞不过，那俺老孙变小了钻进去总行吧？蜜蜂在空中盘旋了一圈，找准角度，朝着叶凛身旁那看似空旷的区域冲了过去。啪叽——蜜蜂像是撞在了汽车挡风玻璃上，直接贴在了半空中，缓缓滑落。孙悟空：“……”他不死心。身形再变。这次化作了一缕青烟，无形无质，随风而动。气体总能渗透进去吧？然而。那缕青烟飘到门口，就像是被一只无形的大手给掐灭了，怎么扭动都无法前进分毫。接着是尘埃、流水、甚至是一道光。孙悟空把他那引以为傲的七十二变使了个遍。每一次尝试，都以那种莫名其妙的撞墙告终。那个门口就像是被整个世界给隔离了，成了独立于三界之外的禁区。而这一切的始作俑者——那个看门的凡人，自始至终都没有看他一眼。叶凛在写东西。在这个没有信号、没有手机、连个说话人都没有的鬼地方，他只能给自已找点乐子。他在写《孙悟空传》。当然，不是编，而是把孙悟空的生平事迹，用一种类似评书或者诗词的方式记录下来。“混沌未分天地乱，茫茫渺渺无人见……”圆珠笔在纸上沙沙作响。叶凛一边写，一边在心里盘算。夏晚晴那个虎妞性格大大咧咧的，最喜欢这种热血上头的调调。如果夏晚晴能成为孙悟空的代行者……叶凛脑补了一下夏晚晴扛着金箍棒，穿着锁子黄金甲，一棒子敲碎一座大楼的画面。别说，还挺带感。“既然来了，总得带点土特产回去。”“神话复苏，唯独华夏神话断层，主角于外神瓜分九州神土之际，高呼孙大圣之名，奋起千钧棒……”“好无聊的背景，好中二的设定。”“不过……估计夏晚晴那假小子喜欢。”叶凛写得很投入。至于旁边那个上蹿下跳、一会儿变苍蝇一会儿变蚊子的猴子？只要他不掏出大规模杀伤性武器，叶凛懒得管。反正有系统兜底。这时候，一只绿头苍蝇不死心地嗡嗡着想要从叶凛的耳边绕过去。叶凛眉头微皱，头也不抬，左手拿着茶缸。他右手顺势把本子一合，对着那只苍蝇就是一拍。啪！精准命中。苍蝇落地，变回了一根被拍扁的毫毛。“天庭的卫生环境堪忧啊。”叶凛自言自语地吐槽了一句。“这么大个蟠桃园，连个灭蚊灯都不装，玉帝这后勤管理不到位啊。”不远处。孙悟空的本尊显现出来。他看着地上那根报废的毫毛，又看了看一脸淡定重新翻开本子的叶凛。心态崩了。他堂堂齐天大圣，在这个凡人眼里，就是个烦人的苍蝇？而且这凡人从头到尾都没正眼看过他！“哇呀呀呀呀！”孙悟空怪叫一声，浑身的猴毛都炸了起来。那股子压抑了许久的凶性，终于在这一刻彻底爆发。去他大爷的！俺老孙今天要是不进这个门，以后还怎么在花果山混？还怎么在三界立足？轰！一股狂暴至极的气势从孙悟空身上冲天而起，周围的云雾瞬间被震散，连带着蟠桃园里的桃树都剧烈摇晃起来。金光大盛。孙悟空不再尝试那些花里胡哨的变化之术。他伸手探向耳中。“大！大！大！”那一根绣花针大小的铁棒迎风便涨，瞬间化作碗口粗细，两头的金箍散发着令人心悸的寒光。如意金箍棒。重一万三千五百斤。但在孙悟空手里，却轻如鸿毛。他单手擎着铁棒，一步一步走到叶凛面前。每走一步，地面的玉石板就崩裂一块。巨大的阴影投射下来，将叶凛整个人笼罩其中。那种来自太乙金仙级别的恐怖威压，如同实质般压在叶凛的肩头。如果是普通人，此刻早就已经被压得骨断筋折，跪地求饶了。但叶凛只是觉得……有点凉快。系统的【岗位技能】不仅给了他绝对的防御，还屏蔽了这种精神层面的威压。毕竟，要是保安被吓尿了，那还怎么看门？叶凛终于停下了手中的笔。他合上本子，慢条斯理地把笔帽盖好，别在上衣口袋里。然后，他抬起头。那双死鱼眼平静地看着面前暴怒的猴王，就像是在看一个闹脾气的熊孩子。“你这小娃娃！”孙悟空手中的金箍棒猛地一指，棒尖距离叶凛的鼻尖只有不到三寸。狂风吹乱了叶凛的头发，但他连眼皮都没眨一下。“用的什么妖法？”“快给俺老孙把这鬼东西撤了！”“不然……”孙悟空呲着牙，露出两排森白的獠牙，眼中的凶光几乎要凝成实质。“俺老孙这一棒下去，你这小身板，怕是要变成肉泥！”
content_en: The extremely arrogant golden auspicious cloud suddenly stopped the car, and the air waves rolled up by inertia made the red armband on Ye Lin's sleeves rustle.The monkey landed.It's not like a fairy landing lightly.Instead, as if he was suffering from late-stage ADHD, he turned directly over the clouds and stepped firmly on the white jade floor tiles with his feet.The impact of golden armor makes a crisp and sweet sound.Sun Wukong changed the hand of the golden cudgel on his shoulder.His wandering eyes first scanned the plaque of Pantaoyuan, and then casually fell on Ye Lin sitting on the pony.A mortal?Sun Wukong scratched the back of his hand covered with golden hair, feeling a little puzzled.When did this heaven become so poor?In such a large peach garden, there are no heavenly soldiers to guard it, and there is no land to greet it.Just let a mortal with no mana fluctuations bask in the sun here?"Hey!" Sun Wukong bared his teeth and let out a strange cry, not taking Ye Lin seriously at all.At this time, Sun Wukong had just made a big fuss in the Heavenly Palace and was named Bima Wen. He was in the expansion period of "I am the best in the world and everyone has to give me face".He took that iconic step of not recognizing the six relatives, and was about to rush into the garden in a swaggering manner.who is he?Monkey King!In this heaven, except for the Lingxiao Palace and the Tushita Palace, he would be a little more restrained. Wouldn't he be able to enter this kind of orchard whenever he wanted?step.Two steps.Just when one of Sun Wukong's feet was about to cross the invisible boundary.Boom——!Sun Wukong was unprepared, and his whole body was thrown backward by the force of the shock, and he took three steps back before he could stand still."Huh?" Monkey was stunned.He reached out and touched his nose, which was a little sore.There was nothing in front of him, not even a ripple of spiritual energy."Which god is joking with me?" Sun Wukong tilted his head, and his powerful mental power swept around the gate of Pantaoyuan like a searchlight.There is no formation.No boundaries.There are no invisible guardian generals.There was only the mortal sitting on the pony, with his head lowered, holding a strange-looking thing, and writing and drawing in a small notebook.Ye Lin didn't even raise his head.Of course he knew the monkey was coming.But his current identity is a security guard.Rule 1 of the Security Code: If the enemy does not move, I will not move; if the enemy moves, I will watch the show; if the enemy forces his way in, he will have his own access control.The [Absolute Access Control] given by the system is a conceptual skill.What is a concept?Even if I say there is a door here, there is a door here.I said this door is locked. Even if you wipe out the way of heaven, you can't get in.Sun Wukong does not believe in evil.He jumped out of a crack in the stone. The word "no" is not in the dictionary in this life."What a strange thing." Sun Wukong slammed the golden cudgel onto the ground, causing the jade ground to buzz."I don't believe it, this broken door can still stop me!" If you can't get in, then fly in!Sun Wukong's body swayed, and his whole body turned into a golden thread, shooting straight into the sky, intending to cross the invisible wall from above.Ye Lin turned over a page, picked up the big teapot with the words "Practice for Heaven" printed on it, and took a sip of wolfberry water.Bang!There was a crisp sound in mid-air.The golden thread seemed to have hit an invisible ceiling, and fell straight down, hitting the ground and smashing into mud."Bah, bah, bah!" Sun Wukong got up from the ground, spat out the grass clippings in his mouth, and the thunderous face turned red.What a shame!Thinking about him being the majestic Monkey King, causing havoc in the Dragon Palace, and forcibly selling off the Book of Life and Death. When had he ever suffered such a secret loss?"I don't believe it!" Sun Wukong was really anxious now.He plucked out a strand of hair, put it to his mouth and blew on it."Change!" The hair swayed in the wind and turned into a bee the size of a fingernail.The wings vibrate and make a buzzing sound.Since the main entrance is impassable and I can't fly from above, then I, Old Sun, should become smaller and sneak into the head office, right?The bee circled in the air, found the right angle, and rushed towards the seemingly empty area next to Ye Lin.Bang - The bee seemed to have hit the car windshield, stuck directly in the air, and slowly slid down.Sun Wukong: "..." He doesn't give up.The body shape changes again.This time it turned into a wisp of green smoke, formless and moving with the wind.Gas can always seep in, right?However.The wisp of green smoke drifted to the door, as if it had been extinguished by an invisible hand. No matter how hard it twisted, it could not move forward at all.Then there was dust, water, and even a light.Sun Wukong performed all seventy-two transformations that he was proud of.Every time I try, I end up hitting a wall.That doorway seemed to be isolated from the entire world and became a restricted area independent of the Three Realms.And the initiator of all this, the mortal guard, never looked at him from beginning to end.Ye Lin is writing something.In this hellish place with no signal, no mobile phone, and no one to talk to, he could only have some fun for himself.He is writing "The Biography of Sun Wukong".Of course, it is not a compilation, but a record of Sun Wukong's life story in a way similar to storytelling or poetry."Chaos is undivided, the sky and the earth are chaotic, and there is no one to see..." The ballpoint pen rustled on the paper.Ye Lin was thinking about it in his mind while writing.Xia Wanqing, a tiger girl with a carefree personality, likes this kind of passionate tone the most.If Xia Wanqing could become the representative of Sun Wukong... Ye Lin imagined a picture of Xia Wanqing carrying a golden hoop, wearing chain-locked golden armor, and smashing a building with one stick.Needless to say, it’s quite touching."Now that I'm here, I have to bring some souvenirs back." "The mythology is revived, but the Chinese mythology is broken. When the outer gods carve up the sacred land of Kyushu, the protagonist shouts the name of Sun Dasheng and rises up..." "What a boring background, a good secondary setting." "But... I guess that tomboy Xia Wanqing likes it." Ye Lin wrote with great devotion.As for the monkey next to you, jumping up and down, changing into a fly and a mosquito?As long as he doesn't take out weapons of mass destruction, Ye Lin doesn't care.Anyway, there is a system to take care of everything.At this time, a blowfly buzzed relentlessly and tried to get around Ye Lin's ear.Ye Lin frowned slightly without raising his head, holding the teapot in his left hand.He closed the notebook with his right hand and swatted the fly.Snap!Accurate hit.The fly landed and turned back into a flattened vellus hair."The sanitary environment in Heaven is worrying." Ye Lin complained to himself."Such a big peach garden doesn't even have a mosquito killer lamp. The logistics management of the Jade Emperor is not in place." Not far away.The true form of Sun Wukong appears.He looked at the scrapped hair on the ground, and then at Ye Lin, who opened the book again with a calm expression.The mentality is broken.He is the majestic Monkey King, but in the eyes of this mortal, he is just an annoying fly?And this mortal never looked at him from the beginning to the end!"Wow, wow, wow!" Sun Wukong screamed strangely, and the monkey hair all over his body exploded.The ferocity that had been suppressed for a long time finally exploded at this moment.Damn it!If I, Old Sun, don't enter this door today, how can I hang out in Huaguo Mountain in the future?How can we gain a foothold in the Three Realms?boom!An extremely violent momentum rose into the sky from Sun Wukong, and the surrounding clouds and mist were instantly shaken away, and even the peach trees in the peach orchard shook violently.The golden light flourishes.Sun Wukong no longer tries those fancy transformation techniques.He reached for his ear."Big! Big! Big!" The iron rod the size of an embroidery needle swelled in the wind and instantly turned into the thickness of a bowl. The golden hoops at both ends emitted a heart-stopping cold light.Ruyi golden hoop.It weighs thirteen thousand five hundred kilograms.But in Sun Wukong's hands, it was as light as a feather.He held the iron rod in one hand and walked step by step to Ye Lin.With every step he took, a piece of the jade slab on the ground cracked.A huge shadow cast down, covering Ye Lin's entire body.The terrifying pressure from the Taiyi Golden Immortal level was pressing on Ye Lin's shoulders like a substance.If he were an ordinary person, he would have been crushed to the point of breaking his bones and tendons, and would have knelt down to beg for mercy.But Ye Lin just felt...a little cool.The system's [Job Skills] not only gave him absolute defense, but also shielded him from this kind of mental pressure.After all, if the security guard is scared to death, how can he guard the door?Ye Lin finally stopped writing in his hand.He closed the notebook, capped the pen slowly and put it in his coat pocket.Then he looked up.Those dead fish eyes looked calmly at the furious Monkey King in front of him, as if they were looking at a child having a tantrum."You little baby!" Sun Wukong pointed at the golden cudgel in his hand. The tip of the cudgel was less than three inches from the tip of Ye Lin's nose.The strong wind ruffled Ye Lin's hair, but he didn't even blink."What magic method was used?" "Get rid of this ghost thing for me, Sun!" "Otherwise..." Sun Wukong bared his teeth, revealing two rows of white fangs, and the fierce light in his eyes almost solidified."If I, Old Sun, strike you with this blow, your small body will probably turn into a pulp!"
